svg.text: SWIM DNOTAM Reference Architecture — Independent Modules
ROLE 1: Your Organization as a CONSUMER

g.text: Production: EUROCONTROL EAD, National AIS, or other certified AISP

svg.text: ROLE 2: Your Organization as a PROVIDER

g.text: • Auto queue creation via AMQ Operator
ANSPs, Airport Operators, Airlines, or any authorized subscriber
(Simulates an External Consumer connecting to Provider)
Consumer and Provider are independent modules with no direct coupling.
Integration happens through Kafka topics: Consumer publishes to business topics, Provider reads from delivery-ready topics. Configure Provider
to read from Consumer's topics for end-to-end integration without intermediaries. Deploy Consumer only, Provider only, or both.
